newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany urges its citizens to leave Sierra Leone.
newsitem.headline: Germany urges its citizens to leave Sierra Leone.

text.p: The German Foreign Ministry on Tuesday said it was recommending that all Germans in Sierra Leone leave the West African country following the military coup there at the weekend.
The ministry added that it strongly advised against any travel to Sierra Leone, where there have been clashes between the coup leaders and those opposed to the new army rulers.
Germany has condemned the coup as a serious blow for democracy in West Africa, and appealed to the coup leaders to refrain from any further violence.

The Foreign Ministry on Monday called for the restoration of constitutional order and said the safety of civilians, members of the deposed government and foreigners in the country had to be guaranteed.
